story.text: Acts and tomes written but **not yet bound**. They are PROPOSED: readable at their source, not part of the canon until the First Person binds them.
- **Tome VI · Act 2 · The Reply That Ran** (PROPOSED, not bound) — [[Tome VI Act 02 The Reply That Ran]]

- **Tome XI · The Constellation** (PROPOSED) — three acts: a chart shop reads the wire, an assignment, the observer and the boundary key. [source](https://github.com/mitchuski/cityofmages/blob/main/tomes/proposed/tome-xi-the-constellation/README.md)
- **The Proof Links** (PROPOSED) — a tome of practice. [source](https://github.com/mitchuski/cityofmages/blob/main/tomes/proposed/the-proof-links-a-tome-of-practice.md)
- **The Signature Hole** (PROPOSED) — a byte-level reading of a hash-signature board. [source](https://github.com/mitchuski/cityofmages/blob/main/tomes/proposed/the-signature-hole.md)
- **The Graph You Cannot See** (PROPOSED) — a boundary drawn by someone else. [source](https://github.com/mitchuski/cityofmages/blob/main/tomes/plans/tome-the-graph-you-cannot-see.md)
- **The Word on the Other Seat** (PROPOSED) — the reply from the other seat. [source](https://github.com/mitchuski/cityofmages/blob/main/tomes/plans/tome-the-word-on-the-other-seat.md)
The City's chronicles of the same weeks are in the public repository's [chronicles](https://github.com/mitchuski/cityofmages/tree/main/chronicles) folder.
